sentences.en: Even the experts took the painting for a genuine Rembrandt.
sentences.zh: 即使是专家也误以为这幅画是伦勃朗的真迹。

sentences.en: Dr. Smith is the most knowledgeable expert in that subject.
sentences.zh: 史密斯博士是那个领域的最权威专家。

sentences.en: Financial experts don't know what to make of this trend.
sentences.zh: 就连金融专家也无法理解这种趋势。
